'''Jazbina''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with luxurious aromatic baths and [[sun crystal]]s.

==History==
Jazbina was a firm supporter of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; under an agreement, as long as Jazbina shipped [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to the Empire, the Empire would remain offworld, even paying a great deal of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] for the ore.

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ruler of the planet, [[Prepredenko]], contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] claiming his planet would like to join them. He met with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who agreed to [[Mission to Jazbina|rescue]] his kidnapped daughter in return. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Syayna]], however, was actually meeting secretly with Rebel agents, since her father was in reality still on the Empire's side.

[[File:Jazbina_streets.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The streets of a Jazbinan city]]

Skywalker led Prepredenko's soldiers directly to her, and she was put under house arrest. She was released, however, upon the [[Mission to Jazbina|arrival]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who imprisoned Prepredenko for supposedly executing Skywalker. With the help of Skywalker and of Rebel pilot [[Jal Te Gniev]], Syayna defeated the Imperial forces with minimal bloodshed and drove Vader away.
